verdict.rationale: Bringing your own model or provider key is a fair question for a cloud coding agent, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no such capability. The API keys in jules-docs-10 are Jules-issued keys for calling the Jules API, not customer-supplied LLM keys. The plan feature 'priority access to the latest models, starting with Gemini 3 Pro' is Google-managed model access, not a user's choice of model or provider.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice
